mostWorthwhile.text: Seeing the kidneys conserve water while the body-water gauge stayed low was most worthwhile: it showed why saving water cannot replace a drink.

leastWorthwhile.text: Getting drinking water into the blood was straightforward and less revealing on its own than comparing it with conservation.

surprise.text: The body could produce less urine and still have a low water level; it needed replacement water too.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained the pairings well enough.
